name: permission-request
notes: State-level alias of the permission-dialog scenario: render_app branches on `app.permission_request` (an Option), not on a `.visible` flag, so overlay_flags tracks it with `.is_some()`. Kept as its own file to preserve the 1:1 surface mapping. Reachable since MockAgentEvent grew a permission_request variant: run_headless already creates the permission_tx/rx pair and App::run already drains it into this dialog, so the mock path just sends on the same channel with_permissions() would.
